name: Logistics Operations core scenarios
description: Real Logistics Operations Q&A pairs grounded in the synthetic seed data (see data/generate_seed_data.py): carrier performance evaluation, shipment tracking on transit lanes, freight cost analysis, and cross-carrier comparison.

parts.text: Which freight carrier has the highest delay rate on West Coast lanes?
Coastal Express Cargo (CARRIER-003) has the highest delay rate on West Coast and regional lanes, with an SLA on-time rate of 78.5% and average delay hours of 18.5 on South-Northeast transit lanes.
What is our average freight cost per shipment for Apex Freight Systems?
Apex Freight Systems (CARRIER-001) has an average freight cost of $1,187.50 per shipment across completed truckload shipments, maintaining a strong 94.5% SLA on-time delivery rate.
Which shipments on Midwest to East Coast lanes are currently delayed?
Shipments SH-1002 and SH-1005 handled by SwiftTrans Logistics on Midwest to East Coast lanes (LANE-002) experienced delivery delays past their expected delivery dates.
How do our freight carriers compare on delivery performance and transit costs?

National Parcel Post leads on-time delivery at 96.0% SLA (parcel mode), followed closely by Apex Freight Systems at 94.5% (truckload mode). SwiftTrans Logistics (82.0% SLA) and Coastal Express Cargo (78.5% SLA) experience higher transit delays, though SwiftTrans offers lower average cost per mile ($2.10).
